reviewSummary: The subject is frozen at its expected digest and mode. All fourteen cited digests reproduce against live bytes. Both Stage A return shapes are recited field-for-field without flattening, including the asymmetry that Claude omits mustFix/shouldFix fields entirely while Codex returns them as empty lists. Every named predecessor identifier exists in the frozen predecessor bytes at the stated severity, and every Codex finding the draft calls unlabeled genuinely carries no identifier value. The leftover-design obligation stays on leftover-join.v32 of G21; the entry measures nothing it is forbidden to measure, and in particular preserves the exact distinction leftover-join.v32 of G21 itself draws between the D-352 injection (already remasured stale) and the per-D-002-platform copies (leftover-design remains). Live tokens — last heading D-353, required-now 28, condition 2 at 5 of 32, condition 4 at 28 of 28, DR-G21 OPEN, DR-107 PROPOSED-CLOSED-FOR-REVIEW, DR-118 DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED, D-272 CONTESTED — all match the draft. The four fixture copies exist, are load-equal to the v26 payload, and no Windows copy was authored. No wording defect of the deictic, bare-token, wrap-split, or predecessor-voiced kind is present. Every listed attack was tested and none landed.
